executivo.nota: Leis: as 89 leis ordinárias e complementares com data a partir de 31/3/2026 cadastradas no SAPL da Câmara, venham de quem vierem (a prefeitura sanciona quase todas). As leis que a própria Câmara promulgou (tipo “Lei Promulgada” no SAPL) ficam fora. Faltam no SAPL cerca de 8 dos 95 números de lei do período, contando as que deveriam vir depois da última cadastrada, de 25/9/2026. Vetos: as mensagens de veto (total ou parcial) que a prefeitura mandou à Câmara a partir de 31/3/2026, cadastradas no SAPL.
executivo.nota_en: Laws: the 89 ordinary and complementary laws dated from March 31, 2026 on in the City Council's SAPL system, whoever proposed them (the mayor's office signs almost all of them). Laws promulgated by the Council itself (type “Lei Promulgada” in SAPL) are left out. About 8 of the 95 law numbers in the period are missing from SAPL, counting those that should have come after the last one recorded, from September 25, 2026. Vetoes: the veto messages (full or partial) the mayor's office sent to the City Council from March 31, 2026 on, as recorded in SAPL.
